questions.q: Which term refers to one specific instance of an object, like the Account 'Acme Corp'?
questions.explain: A record is one specific instance of an object — the actual row of data, like the Account record 'Acme Corp.'

questions.q: Which term describes the server cluster your org is physically hosted on?
questions.explain: Instance (sometimes called a 'pod') refers to the specific server cluster hosting your org, alongside many other companies' orgs.

questions.q: What is the difference between a profile and a permission set?
options: A permission set is a type of report; a profile is a type of dashboard
They are exactly the same thing with two different names
A profile is every user's one baseline access record; a permission set is an additional, stackable grant layered on top
A profile only applies to Sandboxes, never to Production
questions.explain: Every user has exactly one profile, which sets baseline access. Permission sets are additional, stackable grants layered on top without needing to change the profile.

questions.q: What is a Sandbox used for?
options: A separate copy of an org used for safely testing changes, isolated from live Production data
A type of custom object used only in nonprofits
The name for Salesforce's mobile app
A report that tracks sales pipeline
questions.explain: A Sandbox is a separate, isolated copy of an org used for testing changes safely before they reach live Production data.

questions.q: Which term refers to Salesforce's marketplace for installable third-party apps and components?
questions.explain: AppExchange, covered back in Chapter 2, is Salesforce's marketplace for installable third-party apps, components, and solutions.
